verdict.rationale: Dynadot advertises search/registration across 'over 600 domain extensions' (dynadot-docs-21), satisfying the breadth requirement, but there is no evidence of per-TLD documentation of special requirements, restrictions, or country-code eligibility rules that a power user would need. Missing for 10: per-TLD restriction/eligibility documentation, country-code-specific requirements, any TLD policy reference pages.
